answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents stake bonds within an interactive game-theoretic multi-agent auditing protocol. Random topological cut verifications act like a swift falcon, pinpointing sparse subgraphs to expose fake identities. If colluding nodes fabricate false consensus, automated stake slashing destroys their collateral, rendering attack expenses superlinear with network size and ensuring no rogue cluster finds haven. Each validated audit acts like an unalterable sonnet of verified identity across the swarm.
